# Bundled third-party assets

| Asset | Version | License | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| Chart.js | 4.4.8 | MIT | https://www.npmjs.com/package/chart.js |
| Alpine.js | 3.14.9 | MIT | https://github.com/alpinejs/alpine |
| AOS | 2.3.4 | MIT | https://github.com/michalsnik/aos |
| Inter via Fontsource | 5.2.5 | SIL Open Font License | https://www.npmjs.com/package/@fontsource/inter |

Original distribution files were extracted from their npm packages.
License files are included alongside them. Tailwind's browser CDN remains
external as requested; the application has its own local layout styles.
